releases.displayName: Patch Notes: Two New Heroes Join the Battle!

items.text: Hello Dragon-Souls!

The latest patch for Heroes of Mount Dragon is live, and it brings reinforcements! Two new playable characters have joined the fray, each with unique abilities, backstories, and Dragon Forms that will reshape your strategies and deepen the world of Mount Dragon.
New playable character: Zenora

Young usher responsible for protecting the passage from the dead. She is very passionate and a little too much in love with life and death. Despite her seductive side, she is very empathetic and, unlike others of her race, she always gives back to the dead who serve her. Now, it's up to her to tell her story and re-open the Soul Gate that imprisons the dead and transforms them into bloodthirsty creatures!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832360/75cf6cf6a9362cb7e10633324f69b2cb7c83754f.png"]
New playable character: Léone

A fierce tactician, she is a galantis of the Frozen Peaks. Since childhood, she only trains physically and mentally to protect her kingdom from the hordes of the deep north. Following the death of her father a few years ago, she joins the prestigious ranks of the Golden Knights. Despite her nobility, her lineage is tainted by an obscure past. After a high betrayal, Leone is tasked with finding the traitors and putting an end to their macabre plans.
Ready to test new build and dominate the battlefield? Update now and dive in!
May the Celestial Dragon be with you!
—The Dev Team
Hello DragonSouls!

A new wave of magic surges through Heroes of Mount Dragon 🐉... The latest update unveils a powerful new force: Altazar 🧙‍♂️ joins the cast! His command of the mystic arts is without equal, and none alive can bend the will of the arcane crystals as he can.
New playable character: Altazar joins the roster!
New Achievements for Altazar and Tiberius at maximum level
Can now disable crossplay via a new gameplay setting
Moderation menu for online games
Overall stability and performance improvements.
Fix long username that could be cropped in Hud
Some narrative subtitles could get stuck forever
Fixed some buttons icons that weren’t set correctly for certain moves in the move list
Fixed a dialog that had ??? as a character and no character portrait.
There's 2 more characters coming up in the near future, stay tuned!
May the Celestial Dragon be with you!
—The Dev Team

releases.displayName: Patch Notes: Tiberius Joins the Fight!

items.text: Hello DragonSouls!

Today we’re unleashing a fresh new update packed with improvements, bug fixes, and something special: a brand-new character joins the fight! Say hello to Tiberius, a fierce new contender who brings raw power and style to the battlefield. Are you ready to test his mettle?
New playable character: Tiberius joins the roster!
Sprint: Added the ability to sprint using the L1 button.
Game Over: The game over screen now triggers only when all players are defeated in multiplayer.
Move List: All local heroes' moves are now accessible in the Move List menu.
Character Selection: In Adventure Mode, players can now change selected heroes at any time by backing out from the map.
Boss Tuning: Morloch (Act 4) now has longer vulnerability windows and a lower total HP for a more dynamic fight.
Combat: Adjusted airborne hang time for enemies to allow better chaining.
Overall stability and performance improvements.
Re-compressed movies to reduce install size.
Fixed connection and player count issues with lobbies.
Fixed unintended FPS limits that could override player settings.
Fixed crash when quitting during the level introduction sequence.
Fixed issues with phase transitions causing some bosses to freeze.
Fixed issues where upgrades were not correctly applied during game sessions.
We can’t wait to see what you think of Tiberius. Dive back in, explore the new flow, and share your thoughts!
May the Celestial Dragon be with you!
—The Dev Team

releases.displayName: Remote Play Together Now Available on Heroes of Mount Dragon! 🐉

items.text: We’ve just flipped the switch on a brand-new way to team up in Heroes of Mount Dragon: Steam’s Remote Play Together feature is officially live!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832360/71d6e906d5dd439497a65a9c73c12ca950a1ed16.png"]
🕹️ Play Together, No Matter Where You Are

You asked, we answered. Whether your friends are across the city or across the world, Remote Play Together lets you adventure side-by-side as if you’re on the same couch. Only one player needs to own the game; just invite your friends from your Steam friends list and dive straight into the action!
💡 What This Means for You
Seamless multiplayer with zero setup required
Instant invites via the Steam Overlay
Voice chat to strategize, coordinate… or just trash talk!
🌍 Join forces, explore the world of Üna, and crush your foes in glorious co-op chaos. It’s never been easier —or more fun— to share the journey.
🎉 Thanks to everyone in the community who requested this feature. Your feedback matters, and it’s shaping the future of Heroes of Mount Dragon!
Ready to rally your allies? Fire up Heroes of Mount Dragon, hit that invite button, and let the adventure begin. ⚔️
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2733070/Heroes_of_Mount_Dragon/"]
